source_documents.title: A “turn-on” intracellular pH probe for the quantitative monitoring of lysosomal alkalization in living cells

reference_evidence_units.quote: Density functional theory calculations and 1H NMR titration revealed that the pH-sensing mechanism of B26 relies on the inhibition of photoinduced electron transfer from the N-(2-hydroxyethyl) piperazine group to the naphthalimide moiety under acidic conditions.
reference_evidence_units.subject: B26
reference_evidence_units.statement: PET from the piperazine quenches the neutral probe.

reference_evidence_units.quote: B26 demonstrated high sensitivity, selectivity, and reversibility in response to H+, and exhibited a remarkable 98-fold increase in fluorescence intensity between pH 2.0 and pH 11.0, with a pKa value of 7.0
reference_evidence_units.subject: B26
